query: How do I cancel an order that hasn't shipped yet?
reference: Go to My Orders, select the order and tap Cancel. Cancelling is free at any time before the order ships (status "Order placed" or "Packed"), and you can cancel the whole order or only some items.
author: seed

query: My order already shows Shipped. Can I still cancel it?
reference: No. Once an order has shipped it can't be cancelled. You can refuse the delivery at the doorstep, or accept it and request a return within the return window. For a refused prepaid order the refund starts once the package is back at the warehouse, usually within 7 days.
author: seed

query: Can I change the size of a shirt in an order I placed this morning?
reference: Sizes, colours, items and quantities can't be changed after an order is placed. Cancel the item before it ships and place a new order. If it has already been delivered, apparel can be exchanged for a different size free of charge within 30 days of delivery.
author: seed

query: I paid ₹1,200 by UPI for an order that hasn't shipped yet and used a single-use coupon on it. If I cancel now, what happens to my money and my coupon?
reference: Cancelling before dispatch is free. The refund (including any shipping fee) is initiated immediately and reaches your UPI account in 1–3 business days. The single-use coupon is restored to your account as long as it hasn't expired; bank offer discounts are not restored.
author: seed

query: How long does standard delivery take to Bengaluru?
reference: Standard delivery takes 2–4 business days in metro cities such as Bengaluru (3–7 business days elsewhere). Orders placed before 2 PM on a business day are dispatched the same day.
author: seed

query: Do you ship to Germany?
reference: No. Outside India, ShopNest ships only to the UAE, Singapore, the UK, the USA, Canada, Australia and Nepal, so Germany is not supported at the moment.
author: seed

query: I'm sending a 7 kg parcel of home goods to Canada. What will the shipping cost?
reference: Shipping to Canada is ₹2,499 for up to 5 kg plus ₹400 for each extra kg, so 7 kg costs ₹2,499 + 2 × ₹400 = ₹3,299. Delivery takes 7–14 business days, and customs duties and import taxes are paid by the recipient on delivery.
author: seed

query: What happens if my next-day express order arrives late?
reference: The express fee is refunded automatically to your ShopNest Wallet within 48 hours; you don't need to contact support. It is not refunded if the delay was caused by an incorrect address or nobody being available to receive the package.
author: seed

query: What is the return window for a laptop?
reference: Electronics such as laptops can be returned within 10 days of delivery, unused, in the original packaging with all accessories. Sign out of all accounts, remove any device lock and factory-reset the laptop before pickup.
author: seed

query: Is there a fee if I return something just because I changed my mind?
reference: Yes. For change-of-mind returns a ₹79 reverse-pickup fee is deducted from your refund. ShopNest Plus members never pay it, and pickup is free when an item is damaged, defective or wrong.
author: seed

query: Can I return a personalised engraved mug?
reference: No. Personalised or engraved products are non-returnable unless they arrive damaged, defective or wrong.
author: seed

query: My shoes don't fit. Is it better to return them or exchange them?
reference: Exchange them: size and colour exchanges for footwear are free within 30 days of delivery, with no pickup or delivery fee, and the new pair is handed over in the same visit. A change-of-mind return would have the ₹79 reverse-pickup fee deducted (unless you are a Plus member). If the new size has a different price, return the pair and place a new order instead.
author: seed

query: How long does a refund take to reach my credit card?
reference: Card refunds reach you 5–7 business days after the refund is initiated. For a return, the refund is initiated once the item passes the quality check, which happens within 2 business days of it reaching the warehouse.
author: seed

query: I paid cash on delivery. How do I get my refund?
reference: COD refunds can't be paid in cash. Choose your ShopNest Wallet (credited within 2 hours) or your bank account by NEFT within 5–7 business days, after adding your account number and IFSC under My Account > Refund Details. The ₹40 COD fee is not refunded unless the item was damaged, defective or wrong.
author: seed

query: My card refund was initiated 10 business days ago and it still hasn't arrived. What should I do?
reference: Card refunds should arrive within 5–7 business days of initiation, so first ask your bank to trace it using the refund reference number (the ARN). If the bank can't find it, contact ShopNest support with your order ID and the reference number, and we will investigate within 48 hours.
author: seed

query: I returned a ₹1,500 kurta because I changed my mind. I'm not a Plus member and I paid by UPI. How much will I get back, and when?
reference: You will get ₹1,421: the ₹1,500 price minus the ₹79 reverse-pickup fee for a change-of-mind return. The refund is initiated after the kurta passes the quality check (within 2 business days of reaching the warehouse) and reaches your UPI account in 1–3 business days.
author: seed

query: What payment methods do you accept?
reference: UPI, credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, RuPay, American Express, Diners Club), net banking, ShopNest Wallet, ShopNest gift cards, NestCoins, EMI (card and cardless) and Cash on Delivery.
author: seed

query: Money was debited from my account but my order wasn't confirmed. What now?
reference: The amount is reversed automatically: UPI debits within 48 hours, and card or net banking debits within 5–7 business days. You don't need to contact us, and you can place the order again at any time.
author: seed

query: Can I pay cash on delivery for a ₹60,000 TV?
reference: No. Cash on Delivery is available only on orders up to ₹50,000, so this order must be paid online, for example by UPI, card, net banking or EMI.
author: seed

query: Is no-cost EMI available on a ₹24,000 phone, and how much would I pay each month over 6 months?
reference: Yes. No-cost EMI is available on orders of ₹10,000 and above with select bank credit cards, for 3 or 6 months. Over 6 months you pay ₹4,000 a month (₹24,000 ÷ 6). Your bank may charge a one-time processing fee of up to ₹199 plus GST, which is not refunded.
author: seed

query: My account got locked after too many wrong passwords. What do I do?
reference: After 5 failed sign-in attempts the account is locked for 30 minutes. Wait 30 minutes and try again, or reset your password straight away with the "Forgot password" link; the reset link goes to your registered e-mail and is valid for 24 hours.
author: seed

query: How do I delete my ShopNest account?
reference: Go to My Account > Privacy > Delete account; deletion is completed within 30 days. First, all orders must be delivered and all returns and refunds completed. Your NestCoins are forfeited, your Wallet balance is refunded to your bank account, and order and invoice records are kept for 8 years as required by tax law.
author: seed

query: Someone called saying they're from ShopNest and asked for my OTP to process a refund. Should I share it?
reference: No. ShopNest never asks for your OTP, password, CVV, UPI PIN or full card number by phone, e-mail, SMS or chat, and never asks you to pay to receive a refund. Don't share it, and report the call to security@shopnest.example.
author: seed

query: I no longer have my old phone number. How do I change the mobile number on my account?
reference: Go to My Account > Profile > Mobile number and choose "I don't have my old number". We then verify you through a link sent to your registered e-mail address, which is valid for 24 hours.
author: seed

query: What warranty comes with a Nestra Bluetooth speaker?
reference: Nestra electronics carry a 1-year ShopNest warranty against manufacturing defects. ShopNest arranges a free pickup and repairs or replaces the item within 10–15 business days. The battery is covered for 6 months.
author: seed

query: Is installation free for a new washing machine?
reference: Yes. Washing machines get free installation and a demo. A technician visits within 48 hours of delivery in metro cities (3–5 days elsewhere). Please don't unbox the machine before the technician arrives.
author: seed

query: How much does ShopNest Care cost for 2 extra years of warranty on a ₹40,000 laptop?
reference: Two extra years cost 12% of the product price: 12% of ₹40,000 = ₹4,800. ShopNest Care must be bought within 30 days of delivery and starts when the brand warranty ends.
author: seed

query: Is assembly free for a ₹3,500 bookshelf?
reference: No. Furniture assembly is free only for furniture priced ₹5,000 and above; below that it costs ₹499. Items marked "Ready to use" need no assembly.
author: seed

query: How can I contact ShopNest customer support?
reference: You can reach the ShopNest support team on 24x7 chat through the ShopNest Help Centre.
author: seed

query: How do NestCoins work and what are they worth?
reference: You earn 1 NestCoin per ₹100 spent (2 for ShopNest Plus members), credited after the item's return window closes. 1 NestCoin = ₹1; you can redeem once you have 100 and pay up to 25% of an order with them. They expire 12 months after they are credited and can't be transferred or cashed out.
author: seed

query: What do I get with ShopNest Plus, and how much does it cost?
reference: ShopNest Plus costs ₹999 a year or ₹129 a month. It includes free standard shipping on every order, free next-day delivery and ₹49 same-day delivery, no ₹79 reverse-pickup fee on change-of-mind returns, 2 NestCoins per ₹100 instead of 1, and early access to the Big Nest Sale.
author: seed

query: My ₹12,000 phone arrived yesterday with a cracked screen. What exactly do I need to do?
reference: Report it within 48 hours of delivery: in My Orders select the item, tap "Report a problem" and add photos of the phone, the packaging and the shipping label. Because it costs ₹10,000 or more, you also need a continuous unboxing video that starts with the sealed package and label. You can then choose a free replacement or a full refund; pickup is free and the refund is initiated as soon as the pickup is done.
author: seed

query: Can I return earbuds after opening the hygiene seal?
reference: No. In-ear earphones and earbuds can't be returned once the hygiene seal is opened, unless they arrived damaged, defective or wrong.
author: seed

query: Can I return earbuds if I have not opened the hygiene seal?
reference: Yes. Unopened earbuds can be returned like other electronics within 10 days of delivery, unused and in the original packaging with all accessories.
author: seed

query: Please cancel order SN-48213, it hasn't shipped yet.
reference: Order SN-48213 hasn't shipped, so it can be cancelled free of charge: go to My Orders, select order SN-48213 and tap Cancel. A prepaid order's refund is initiated immediately.
author: seed

query: Please cancel order SN-48231, it hasn't shipped yet.
reference: Order SN-48231 hasn't shipped, so it can be cancelled free of charge: go to My Orders, select order SN-48231 and tap Cancel. A prepaid order's refund is initiated immediately.
author: seed

query: How long is the warranty on Nestra headphones?
reference: Nestra headphones, like other Nestra electronics, carry a 1-year ShopNest warranty against manufacturing defects; the battery is covered for 6 months.
author: seed

query: How long is the warranty on a Nestra mattress?
reference: Nestra mattresses carry a 5-year warranty against sagging deeper than 25 mm and against manufacturing defects in the foam or springs.
author: seed

query: I want a refund for the jeans I bought last week, they don't fit.
reference: Start a return from My Orders within 30 days of delivery. A ₹79 reverse-pickup fee is deducted for a change-of-mind return unless you are a Plus member, and the refund goes to your original payment method after the quality check. For a size problem, a free exchange is usually the better option.
author: seed

query: I want to exchange the jeans I bought last week for a bigger size.
reference: Go to My Orders, select the jeans, tap Exchange and pick the new size. Exchanges are free within 30 days of delivery, the new pair is handed over when the old one is picked up (usually within 3–5 business days), the tags must still be attached, and each item can be exchanged only once.
author: seed

query: How much does shipping cost for an order within India?
reference: Standard shipping is free on orders of ₹499 and above (after discounts); orders below ₹499 pay ₹49. ShopNest Plus members get free standard shipping on every order.
author: seed

query: How much does shipping cost for an order to Singapore?
reference: Shipping to Singapore costs ₹1,499 per order for parcels up to 5 kg, plus ₹400 for each extra kg, and takes 7–14 business days. Customs duties and import taxes are paid by the recipient.
author: seed

query: I want to cancel my order SN-20931.
reference: If order SN-20931 hasn't shipped yet, cancel it free of charge from My Orders: select the order and tap Cancel. Once it has shipped it can't be cancelled; refuse the delivery or return it instead.
author: seed

query: I want to track my order SN-20931.
reference: Track order SN-20931 under My Orders, or with the tracking link sent by SMS, e-mail and WhatsApp once it ships. Tracking updates can take up to 24 hours to appear after dispatch.
author: seed
